title: Maintain legal entities and sites
description: The tenant administrator keeps the list of the company's legal entities (a code, a name, a 12-digit BIN) and sites (a place the company works at, belonging to a legal entity): adds, renames or corrects, and retires them. A retired entity or site is hidden from new work but never deleted.
preconditions: module org installed on the tenant
the administrator is signed in (a person, not a shared access value)

tasks.result: a legal entity with a code, a name and a BIN of exactly 12 digits (201); a second live entity with the same BIN is refused (422 bin_taken)
name, BIN or external reference corrected (200); the code cannot be changed (422 field_not_allowed)
the entity is inactive (200); refused while a live site or unit still names it
a site of a live legal entity (201); an unknown or inactive entity is refused
site name or legal entity changed (200)
the site is inactive (200); refused while a live unit names it

refusals: a role without OrgStructureWrite (the STOREKEEPER, the auditor): 403
a body with a key outside the allow-list: 422 field_not_allowed; a malformed BIN or empty name: 422 field_invalid
a second live legal entity with the same BIN: 422 bin_taken (a retired entity's BIN may be reused)
an unknown id, or an id of another tenant: the same 404

title: Maintain the org unit tree
description: The tenant administrator builds the organisation as a tree of units (department, shop, team): adds a unit under a legal entity and a site, optionally under a parent unit, renames or re-assigns it, moves it under another parent, and retires it.
preconditions: a live legal entity and a live site exist (BP-MASTER-01)

tasks.result: a unit, root or under a live parent (201)
name, legal entity or site changed (200)
the unit and its subtree sit under the new parent (200); a move into its own subtree is refused (cycle)
the unit is inactive (200)

refusals: 403 for a role without OrgStructureWrite
422 cycle / depth_exceeded / parent_inactive / legal_entity_inactive / site_inactive with the fixed reason
an unknown or foreign unit or parent id: the same 404

title: Maintain positions and employees
description: The tenant administrator records the posts of each unit and the people who hold them: adds a position to a unit, an employee to a unit (optionally with a position and the login user), changes their data, transfers an employee to another unit and position, and retires them.
preconditions: for a login link: the user exists in this tenant

tasks.result: a position of an active unit (201)
name changed (200); a position never moves between units
the position is inactive (200)
an employee of an active unit; the position must be active and of that unit; the user must belong to this tenant (201)
name or login user changed (200); the unit changes only by transfer
the employee is in the new unit with a position of that unit (200)
the employee is inactive (200)

refusals: 403 for a role without OrgEmployeesWrite
422 unit_inactive, field_invalid, record_payload_invalid (duplicate code)
a user of another tenant: the same 404 user_not_found

title: Maintain the location tree
description: The tenant administrator builds the tree of places goods and assets are kept at (warehouse, zone, shelf, bin): adds a place (the address may be composed from the parents' segments), renames it, moves it under another place or to the top, and retires it. A place with live sub-places cannot be retired.

tasks.result: a place, root or under an active parent (201); address_pattern 'segments' composes the address
name or attributes changed (200)
the place sits under the new parent, or at the top for a null parent (200); a cycle is refused
the place is inactive (200); refused 422 has_active_descendants while a live sub-place exists

refusals: 403 for a role without LocationsWrite
422 cycle, has_active_descendants, parent_inactive, field_invalid (address_pattern other than segments)
unknown or foreign id: the same 404

title: Link org units to locations
description: The tenant administrator says which places an org unit works at, so that a unit's people see only their places. A link is created, or reactivated if it was removed, and removed (made inactive; never deleted).
preconditions: a live org unit (BP-MASTER-02) and a live location (BP-MASTER-04) exist

tasks.result: an active link (201, also when an inactive one is reactivated); a retired unit or place is refused
the link is inactive (200); a pair without an active link is the same 404

refusals: 403 for a role without LocationsWrite
422 unit_inactive / location_inactive
unknown unit, place or link: the same 404

title: Load the catalog (units, items, counterparties) from a file
description: Items, units of measure and counterparties are not typed in on a screen: the tenant administrator loads them from a CSV or Excel file with the generic import (one row per record, an external reference for each), as a trial run first and then for real. A row that names an unknown unit or place is refused and writes nothing; re-loading the file updates the same records. The Items screen then shows the result, read only.
preconditions: for default_location_id: module locations installed and the place loaded first

tasks.result: catalog_uom, catalog_item and catalog_counterparty rows created or updated by external reference, one audit entry per changed row
the administrator and the storekeeper (both hold StockRead, the guard of the Items screen) read the items on the Items screen (a query, no write route)

inputs: a file of rows with external_ref_system and external_ref_id
refusals: the STOREKEEPER holds Import but not EntitiesRecordsImportAnyType: 403 for any type but stock_opening_line
more than 200 records in one request, a bad schema version, an unknown column or a malformed file: refused before any row is written
an unknown or retired reference (unit, place): the row is refused, nothing written
a managed type without an import function: 403 entity_type_managed

title: Load org units, locations and codes from a file
description: To seed a new tenant the administrator loads legal entities, sites, units, location nodes, code tags and code assignments with the same generic import, in dependency order (org, then locations, then catalog, then codes). Each row goes through the owning module's own import function, so the same rules and audit as the screens apply.
preconditions: the modules org, locations, catalog_items and codes are installed

tasks.result: rows created or updated by external reference; a code assignment row needs its tag and target loaded first

refusals: a role without EntitiesRecordsImportAnyType: 403
a row that names a missing parent or target: refused, nothing written

title: Maintain lots of an item
description: The tenant administrator records a lot (batch) of an active item with a code, a producer, a mark and an expiry date, corrects it and retires it. One item has one lot per code.

tasks.result: a lot of an active item (201); a retired item is refused (item_inactive); a second lot code for the item is refused (422 record_payload_invalid)
producer, mark or expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) corrected (200); the item and the code cannot change
the lot is inactive (200)

refusals: CatalogLotsWrite has no role grant: only TENANT_ADMIN and PLATFORM_ADMIN; the STOREKEEPER gets 403
an unknown or foreign item or lot: the same 404
an invalid date: 422 field_invalid

title: Receive, assign, release and retire a code
description: Barcodes, QR codes and RFID tags are first received into the tenant (a batch of values with a kind), then assigned to one place, item or lot, released when the label is taken off, given a new value if the tag is rewritten, and retired when it is lost or destroyed. A scan afterwards shows what the code points at.
preconditions: a live location, item or lot to assign to

tasks.result: one not_assigned code per entry, all or nothing (201); at most 1000 entries; a taken value is refused with its index
the code is assigned to one target of type location_node, catalog_item or catalog_lot (200); a second open assignment is refused
the scan answer: status, kind, target type and id (the storekeeper scans in the mobile app; no web screen calls this route)
the code is not_assigned again (200)
the code keeps its record and gets a new value; the old value goes to the value history (200)
the code is retired and its open assignment is closed (200)

refusals: CodesWrite: only TENANT_ADMIN and PLATFORM_ADMIN; the STOREKEEPER gets 403
422 entry_invalid (index, reason), batch_size, code_retired, value_taken, assignment_conflict
unknown code or target, or one of another tenant: the same 404

title: Print code labels
description: A tenant administrator picks up to 1000 received codes on the Codes screen and prints their labels as one PDF (a Code 128 label each, in the order chosen). Nothing is written. The route itself needs only CodesRead, so the STOREKEEPER may call it through the API, but no screen lets that role in: the Codes screen needs CodesWrite.

tasks.result: a PDF attachment 'code-labels.pdf', one label per code in list order (200)

refusals: an empty list, more than 1000 ids or a non-text id: 422 field_invalid
a repeated id: 422 entry_invalid duplicate_in_batch
an id that is not a live code of the tenant: the same 404
a value that cannot be printed as Code 128: 422 entry_invalid

title: Security: permission matrix of the master data routes
description: Who may do what in org, locations, catalog lots and codes, and who is refused. The administrator holds every write permission; the STOREKEEPER holds only CodesRead (scan lookup and label print, through the API and the mobile scan screen) and gets 403 on every write; roles without these permissions get 403 as well.

actors.permission: OrgStructureWrite, OrgEmployeesWrite, LocationsWrite, CatalogLotsWrite, CodesWrite, CodesRead

preconditions: the four modules are installed on the tenant (on a tenant without a module its routes answer 404)

tasks.result: every write route refused with 403 and nothing written; the two reads of the role are allowed

refusals: STOREKEEPER on any write route of the four modules: 403
TENANT_AUDITOR, PROCESS_DESIGNER, PROCESS_OPERATOR, TASK_WORKER on a write route: 403 (Elixir tests router_test.exs H-cases)
the scan lookup and the label print are open to the STOREKEEPER

security_scenarios.name: storekeeper refused on 17 write routes, allowed on resolve and labels
auditor, designer, operator, worker refused
security_scenarios.note: no roster actor yet; Elixir router tests cover it

title: Security: another tenant's data is never reachable (uniform 404)
description: A token of tenant A used on an id that belongs to tenant B, on every master route that takes an id, answers the same 404 as an id that does not exist; nothing in tenant B changes. No route takes a tenant from the path or the body: a body with tenant_id is refused (see BP-MASTER-13).
preconditions: two tenants with the modules installed: home qoimeks-qa2 and foreign sss-rehearsal2 (stock tenant, holds locations and org units)

tasks.result: 404 with the body of an unknown path, the record of tenant B unchanged

refusals: an id of another tenant, a deleted record or an unknown id: the same 404 (INV-5)
a code assigned to a scoped or undeclared target type: the scan lookup answers the 404 of an unknown code (fail closed)

security_scenarios.name: rename of the other company's location and org unit refused, both directions (SEC-MASTER-02)
codes cross-tenant
security_scenarios.note: no foreign code guaranteed; Elixir codes router_test T1 covers it

title: Security: crafted write requests are refused and change nothing
description: Bodies that no screen sends: an unknown key or a tenant id, no idempotency key, a bad option, an unknown id, the same idempotency key with another body, an empty or oversized code batch. Each answer is a fixed 422 reason, 404 or 409, and nothing is written (a refused call leaves no record and no audit entry).
preconditions: modules locations, org and codes installed

tasks.result: 422 field_not_allowed / field_invalid / batch_size, 404, 409 idempotency_key_reuse; no record changed

refusals: an extra key (tenant_id included): 422 field_not_allowed; a missing key: 422 field_invalid
no idempotency_key: 422 field_invalid
the same key with another body: 409 idempotency_key_reuse
address_pattern other than 'segments': 422 field_invalid

security_scenarios.name: extra key, missing key, bad address_pattern, unknown ids, empty batch, key reuse

title: Security: token, host and old-address lookups
description: A call with no credential, a wrong or expired token, a token of another tenant never reaches a master route's handler. Not in this area: voice and webhook inputs, four-eyes approval and the old shared-access address - none of the four routers accepts them (the shared access value reaches stock routes only). The unknown-host case is not claimed here: no source for it was found in this area.

actors.permission: none needed: the call is refused first

tasks.result: 401 without a credential (missing or malformed Authorization header), 401 for a wrong or expired token, 401 for a token whose realm does not match the tenant; nothing written

refusals: no credential or a wrong token: 401
a path that no route of the module has: the ordinary unmatched answer (authz_unmatched)

security_scenarios.name: no credential: 401 on one write route per module and on the two codes reads (SEC-MASTER-03)
wrong, expired or other-tenant token, unknown host
security_scenarios.note: needs a per-step bearer in the runner; Elixir auth pipeline tests cover it

title: Security: import types, size and format limits
description: The generic import loads master data from files. Only a holder of EntitiesRecordsImportAnyType loads module-managed types; the STOREKEEPER only opening lines. A request over 200 records, with a wrong schema version, an unreadable or oversized xlsx, a header that is not a field, or a malformed CSV is refused before any row is written.

tasks.result: 403 for catalog_item, locations, org and codes types; 413 / 422 with a reason for limits

refusals: the STOREKEEPER importing catalog_item: 403
more than 200 records: 413 before any row validation (for a file import, a type the caller cannot see answers 404 first, record_import.ex:325)
xlsx_unreadable, xlsx_too_large, csv_malformed, csv_unknown_header: 422 with the reason

security_scenarios.name: storekeeper refused on a master type; limits
security_scenarios.note: needs a file upload step in the runner; Elixir tests: import_test.exs of each module and the entities import tests

title: Security: the scan lookup fails closed
description: A scan of an unknown code, or of a code assigned to a record type whose scope is not tenant-wide or not declared, is the same 404 for the caller: it cannot tell a missing code from a hidden one. A retired or conflicting code answers 200 with only the sent value and null fields.
preconditions: one code assigned to a catalog_item or location_node

tasks.result: 404 for an unknown value; 200 with the target for a tenant-wide target

refusals: unknown code: 404
assigned to a scoped or undeclared target type: the same 404 (decision 0076 R7 ruling 2)

security_scenarios.name: unknown value gives 404 (also step s18 of BP-MASTER-11)
scoped target hidden
security_scenarios.note: needs a scoped target type on the tenant; Elixir resolve_router_test covers it

title: Security: the master data modules have no process to start or complete
description: The four master data modules own no process definition, no task node and no write handler (inventory of the area: no pack node, no handler). A start of a process named after a module, with start values chosen by the caller, is the 404 of a process that does not exist; the role that may not start processes gets 403. Crafted completion, write-target refusal (output_refused) and sub-process start do not apply to this area: there is no task and no module_writes line to target.
preconditions: modules org, locations, catalog_items and codes installed

tasks.result: 404 with the answer of an unknown process for each module name; STOREKEEPER 403; nothing started

refusals: start by the name of a master data module: 404 (no such definition)
STOREKEEPER on the start route: 403

security_scenarios.name: start by module name refused; storekeeper 403
crafted completion, sub-process start
security_scenarios.note: no process definition in the four packs (definitions: [] in each pack.json)

title: Security: a repeated write with the same key gives the same record
description: Every master data write carries an idempotency key. The same key with the same body returns the first result and creates one record; the same key with another body is 409 idempotency_key_reuse. Walked on a location and on a received code; the cleanup retires both.

tasks.result: replay: same record id, one record; same key other body: 409 idempotency_key_reuse

refusals: same key, other body: 409 idempotency_key_reuse

security_scenarios.name: replay and key reuse on a location and on a code batch

title: Security: master data business rules hold (tree, codes)
description: Rules of the area, each refused with a fixed reason and nothing written: a location cannot be moved under its own descendant (cycle); a location with a live child cannot be retired (has_active_descendants); a child cannot be put under a retired parent (parent_inactive); an unknown parent is the 404 of an unknown id; a code value that already exists, or repeats inside a batch, is refused entry_invalid; an empty batch is refused batch_size. Org unit cycle and depth rules (org.ex moduledoc, :cycle, :depth_exceeded) are covered by the Elixir org tests only.

tasks.result: 422 cycle / has_active_descendants / parent_inactive / entry_invalid / batch_size; 404 unknown parent; nothing written

refusals: cycle
has_active_descendants
parent_inactive
entry_invalid (value_taken, duplicate_in_batch)
batch_size
